title: Ancient Greek philosophy
learning_outcomes: Explain socratic inquiry in the context of ancient greek philosophy.
Compare and distinguish plato in the context of ancient greek philosophy.
Apply aristotle in the context of ancient greek philosophy.
Evaluate and justify decisions about historical argument in the context of ancient greek philosophy.

lessons.title: Socratic inquiry
lessons.outcome: Explain socratic inquiry in the context of ancient greek philosophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving socratic inquiry; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to comparative philosophy essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain socratic inquiry from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of socratic inquiry; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Plato
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish plato in the context of ancient greek philosophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving plato; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to comparative philosophy essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain plato from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of plato; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Aristotle
lessons.outcome: Apply aristotle in the context of ancient greek philosophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving aristotle; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to comparative philosophy essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain aristotle from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of aristotle; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Historical argument
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about historical argument in the context of ancient greek philosophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving historical argument; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to comparative philosophy essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain historical argument from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of historical argument; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of socratic inquiry; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of plato; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of aristotle; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of historical argument; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Philosopher or scholar of relevant tradition; avoid treating one tradition as universal.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
